title: DashboardProposal
description: A proposed dashboard produced by an agent (or a fixture). Carries NO ids — nothing is minted until the proposal is applied via POST /api/dashboards/apply-proposal. Data panels reference an existing pipeline-output DataType by id.

type.description: No `divider`: excluded from the agent-facing set by an explicit, stated product-scope reason (purely presentational layout chrome, nothing an agent can author), mirrored by create_panel's enum (see scripts/lib/agentFacingPanelTypes.mjs). Every other canonical kind is on this wire because the wire can express its required binding: `output` binds `outputId`, `form` binds `dataSourceId` (HEL-1148).

outputId.description: Required for `output` panels — the id of the pipeline-owned Output the panel binds to (renamed HEL-910 task 3.2 from the legacy `dataTypeId` name). Omitted for text/markdown/image panels — TextPanelConfig/MarkdownPanelConfig no longer carry a data binding of any kind (pipelines-and-outputs remodel, HEL-903/904).

dataSourceId.description: Required for `form` panels, and only `form` panels (HEL-1148) — the id of a caller-owned `dataset` source the form appends submitted rows to. A `form` with no `dataSourceId`, one that is not a caller-owned `dataset` source, or one whose fields do not fit that dataset's declared schema is rejected with a 400 naming the panel, before anything is created. Authoritative over `config.dataSourceId`; a `config.dataSourceId` alone is NOT a binding. A `form` may not also carry `outputId`, and `dataSourceId` on any other panel type is rejected.

fieldMapping.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: buildDataConfig emits only {outputId} for an `output` panel (see the outputId description above) — fieldMapping is not passed through. Also not used by text/markdown/image panels — TextPanelConfig/MarkdownPanelConfig carry no data binding to map fields against (pipelines-and-outputs remodel, HEL-903/904).

aggregation.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: viz-level aggregation belonged to the metric/chart panel kinds, which were deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904) along with the aggregation concept those kinds carried. Retained on the wire for schema stability only.

content.description: Initial body for text/markdown panels. Ignored for other panel types.

url.description: Initial image URL for image panels (mapped internally to config.imageUrl). Ignored for other panel types.

orientation.description: Initial orientation for divider panels. Ignored for other panel types.

chartType.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: the chart panel kind was deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904). Retained on the wire for schema stability only.

xAxisLabel.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: the chart panel kind was deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904). Retained on the wire for schema stability only.

yAxisLabel.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: the chart panel kind was deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904). Retained on the wire for schema stability only.

seriesColors.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: the chart panel kind was deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904). Retained on the wire for schema stability only.

label.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: the metric panel kind was deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904). Retained on the wire for schema stability only.

unit.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: the metric panel kind was deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904). Retained on the wire for schema stability only.

sort.description: Legacy field, decoded but never applied: the timeline panel kind was deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904). Retained on the wire for schema stability only.

config.description: Optional generic passthrough merged over the config derived from the flat fields above, then decoded by the same panel-create path as POST /api/panels. Current surfaces: output {outputId}; text/markdown {content}; image {imageUrl}. On key conflict this wins over a derived flat field, EXCEPT an `output` panel's outputId (see the outputId description above), which always stays the flat-field value. text/markdown panels carry no outputId/fieldMapping of any kind (TextPanelConfig/MarkdownPanelConfig, pipelines-and-outputs remodel HEL-903/904) — a `config.outputId` on a text/markdown panel is silently inert, not a binding attempt. The collection/timeline/chart/table/metric config surfaces (baseType/layout, timelineOptions, chartOptions, density/columnOrder) were deleted by the pipelines-and-outputs remodel (HEL-903/904) along with the panel kinds that carried them.

controls.description: HEL-1193: controls (date-range/dropdown/numeric-range/text) to configure on an `output` panel, validated at propose time and at apply by the SAME rule the panel write path uses (a control is eligible only for the kinds its column's `controlKinds` lists in GET /api/outputs/:id/filter-capabilities). An ineligible control is rejected 400 with `control not eligible: column '<c>', kind '<k>'`. Only valid on an `output` panel, and not together with `config.controls`. On a combined proposal, a panel bound to the `$pipelineOutput` sentinel is validated only at apply.

id.description: Optional; minted at apply when absent.

defaultValue.description: Never server-validated; JSON string for text/dropdown, {min,max} for numeric-range, {from,to} for date-range.
